description: Public details of one Roraima listing: name, description, town, stay rules, cancellation policy, registration number, amenities and the link to its page. No host contact details. amenities (nights listings only) lists what the host has stated, each with an English code, the value and the sentence the listing page shows in the language asked; applies_to tells whether it describes the listing or the whole property. An amenity not listed has not been stated: it is unknown, not absent.

language.description: Language of names, descriptions and page links. Default en.

name: get_listing
title: Read a listing
